name: Query Parameter Pollution Test Cases
note: Request templates, not URL-value payloads. Use a raw/order-preserving query builder. Replace placeholders and URL-encode values once at the outer query layer.

cases.name: allowed-first-attacker-second
cases.purpose: Determine whether the server uses first or last duplicate value.

cases.name: attacker-first-allowed-second
cases.purpose: Reverse order to distinguish first-value and last-value behavior.

cases.name: duplicate-with-benign-middle
cases.purpose: Check whether intervening parameters affect duplicate-key resolution.

cases.name: case-variant-key
cases.purpose: Check parameter-name case sensitivity; this is not an exact duplicate on case-sensitive frameworks.

cases.name: comma-joined-values
cases.purpose: Check application-specific comma splitting; not standard duplicate-key behavior.

cases.name: semicolon-separator
cases.purpose: Check frameworks that optionally treat semicolon as a query separator.

cases.name: encoded-parameter-name
cases.purpose: Check whether parameter-name decoding changes key matching.

cases.name: existing-value-plus-injected-duplicate
cases.purpose: Preserve the original query and append a duplicate key; compare original application behavior.
